g.text: source : text (FreePlan | Payment | Contract | Trial | Courtesy | Complimentary)
scheduled_end_at : timestamptz (immutable; empty only for FreePlan, Contract, Complimentary)
subscription_id + addon_key (c idx where not ended)
A fact in time: in force while ended_at is empty.
Only a Standalone customer account subscribes;
at most one subscription in force per account.
One timeline: which plan, and why it is covered.
Terms never overlap. Nothing works (plan, add-ons,
grants) unless a term covers now; its plan is the
current plan. FreePlan terms only for Free plans.
Terms never start in the future.
Only where it adds something: an unmetered
feature the account lacks, or a metered quota
(added to the total). Active = not ended and
not expired; sys_grant_expiry records the end.
Support records which change request created it.
unique index — s: single column · c: composite
solid line: within the subsystem · dashed: another subsystem
